use_when: to separate groups of related content.
Use a solid divider for standard separation, such as between footer links and the copyright text, or between Sidebar groups.
Use a dashed divider for a lighter, secondary break, such as inside an order summary or between optional details.
Use a divider between rows when a Table needs extra structure.

dont_use_when.when: if spacing alone already groups the content clearly.
Do not stack two dividers back to back.
Do not change the thickness of a divider.

best_practice: Use the same style (solid or dashed) for the same job across a screen.
Make the divider as wide as the content it separates.
Keep equal space above and below the line.

variant_intent.isDashed=false: Figma: solid line, for standard separation.
variant_intent.isDashed=true: Figma: dashed line, for a lighter, secondary break.

a11y.fact: Renders a native <hr>, which carries the separator role.
